name: Phoenician

historicalPeriod.text: Evolved from about the twelfth century BCE until the second century BCE.

geographicDistribution.text: The alphabet and its successors were widely used around the Mediterranean Sea.

directionality.text: Written horizontally from right to left.

characteristics.text: Letters of Phoenician proper, and especially Punic, have very exaggerated descenders.

relationships.text: Described as a forerunner of the Greek, Old Italic, Latin, Hebrew, Arabic, and Syriac scripts.

limitations: Letter forms changed across the period and region, and a single reference glyph cannot show this.
The sources read do not state a letter count here.
